episodes.title: Inside Zimbabwe's Most Notorious Cult: Robert Gumbura⁠
episodes.description:
He preached salvation… but behind closed doors, a nightmare unfolded.

Robert Martin Gumbura built one of Zimbabwe’s most controversial religious empires, presenting himself as a wealthy, God-appointed leader while secretly abusing his power for years.

This documentary uncovers the shocking rise and fall of the man known as “The Wolf of Marlborough.” From his luxurious lifestyle, multiple wives, and growing church empire to the dramatic police raid, emotional courtroom testimony, conviction, imprisonment at Chikurubi Maximum Prison, and his final days behind bars, this is one of Zimbabwe’s most disturbing true crime stories.

⚠️ Viewer discretion is advised. This documentary discusses sexual abuse, manipulation, and psychological control.
